segments.text: Stage three, unit seven. Small words, big work.
This unit is about particles. Each one is called a ḥarf.
A ḥarf never changes, and it has no iʿrāb place.
Its job is to work on the words around it.
Chapter one. Every ḥarf is fixed, with no place.
Pronouns, pointing words and question isms are fixed.
But they still have a place. Rafʿ, naṣb or jarr.
A ḥarf is different. It is fixed, and it has no place at all.
cues: hl:It is fixed and it has no place at all.

segments.text: Here is the phrase we use for a ḥarf.
حَرْفٌ مَبْنِيٌّ لَا مَحَلَّ لَهُ مِنَ الإِعْرَابِ
cues: hl:حَرْفٌ مَبْنِيٌّ لَا مَحَلَّ لَهُ مِنَ الإِعْرَابِ

segments.text: A fixed ḥarf with no place in iʿrāb.
cues: hl:A fixed ḥarf with no place in iʿrāb.

segments.text: This unit has five groups of ḥarfs.
First, the jarr ḥarfs, such as from, to and in.
The joining ḥarfs, like wa, which means and.
The answer ḥarfs, for yes and no.
The question ḥarfs, for a yes or no question.
And the calling ḥarf, to call someone.
Let us take them one by one.
